title: Open descriptor verification protocol
description: A file observed by name and opened later may differ from the observation for three different reasons, and each reason has its own verdict. `append-only` (a journal or index that siblings append to): the identity is the device, inode and link count, the size may only grow, and the volatile modification and change times are not part of it. `immutable` (a file nobody may touch while it is open): every stamp field must match; a mismatch is observed again a bounded number of times and then reported as a concurrent edit of the `read` layer of the churn policy. `renamed` (a file replaced atomically by rename): the open descriptor must be the file the name denotes now; when the name moved on, the file is opened by name again and verified again, bounded.

append-only.en: append-only file was replaced, linked again or shortened while it was open
append-only.de: anhängbare Datei wurde ersetzt, neu verlinkt oder gekürzt, während sie offen war

immutable.en: file changed while it was open
immutable.de: Datei hat sich geändert, während sie offen war

renamed.en: file was replaced again while it was opened by name
renamed.de: Datei wurde beim Öffnen über den Namen erneut ersetzt
